name: membrane
description: Free skills for e-commerce back-office work. Your own AI agent runs them on your computer, with no sign-up, and your data stays there.

interface.shortDescription: Free e-commerce back-office skills for your agent
interface.longDescription: Membrane runs the back office for e-commerce brands. This plugin gives you some of the same skills for free, inside Claude Code, Codex, or the ChatGPT desktop app. Each skill reads your data in one of the apps you sell or advertise through and tells you what to fix. The skills run on your computer and need no sign-up. You connect each app through Membrane's sign-in page, and the tokens and the data stay on your computer.
defaultPrompt: What did my Amazon ads cost and earn last month?
